testcase.name: every term carries its own name, real copy, and a class-consistent severity
an empty provider list is not an error and produces no providers
every state and every action has real copy, not its token
unknown state, term and action throw rather than rendering blank
a non-permitted provider is never selectable, even when the feed lies
the adapter carries the presentation version so the two surfaces can be compared
the decision flag and structural flag travel from the feed unchanged
severity cannot contradict the contract class, and STATE terms are bounded instead
raw vocabulary is reachable only through the explicit detail block
a failed run is the one state emphasised as blocked
